summary: Optional otel_ui_url in the slo read and [observations.otlp] ui_url in the config

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: Targets, windows and statuses are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: client-v0 SloList gains an optional otel_ui_url, present only when the daemon is configured with one; older clients ignore it. [observations.otlp] accepts a new optional ui_url (an http or https address). A daemon from before this build rejects a config that sets it, so set it only after every member runs this build.

downtime.detail: No data migration. The setting is read at daemon start.

manual.detail: To show a link to the observation history in the usage pane, set ui_url under [observations.otlp] and restart the daemon. Without it nothing changes.

recovery.detail: Remove ui_url from the config before running an older version: an older daemon refuses to start with the key. Nothing writes it by default (setup, the installer and doctor leave it out), so only a config that set it by hand needs the edit.
